Step 3 of v1.3.2 shipped 2026-04-24: UncertaintyResurfacer daemon + entry-point + launchd plist template.

Files:
  - src/sovereign_stack/daemons/__init__.py (package surface)
  - src/sovereign_stack/daemons/senders.py (daemon.* taxonomy, ALL_DAEMON_SENDERS frozenset)
  - src/sovereign_stack/daemons/uncertainty_resurfacer.py (UncertaintyResurfacer class, ~470 LOC)
  - src/sovereign_stack/daemons/entrypoint.py (launchd entry point — the ONLY place real deps wire in)
  - tests/test_uncertainty_resurfacer.py (25 tests, all green — 413 total passing)
  - scripts/com.templetwo.sovereign.uncertainty.plist.template (user-scoped, ~/Library/LaunchAgents)

THE LOAD-BEARING TEST: test_ack_is_distinct_from_read_by. Posts 3 digests, populates read_by on each (simulating browse glances), never calls comms.acknowledge(). The 4th run MUST halt. If a future refactor collapses read_by into ack, this test fails and every downstream daemon's circuit breaker breaks. Guard it.

Design calls (with rationale, so Step 4+ doesn't re-litigate):

1. CONSECUTIVE_UNACKED_THRESHOLD = 3. Roughly 9 days at 3-day cadence — real signal, short enough for weekly review catch. 2 too jumpy; 4 too slow.

2. Templated digest, zero LLM calls inside the daemon. No hallucination surface. Future natural-language passes go through a separate grounded_extract gate, not woven into the core loop.

3. Circuit breaker checks get_acknowledgments(message_id), NOT read_by. The v1.3.1 acknowledgment split is the ONLY architectural reason halt-on-unack can work.

4. grounded_extract called even though there's no LLM output to verify — the invariant "every daemon calls grounded_extract before comms post" must hold uniformly across Step 3-6 for downstream tooling to trust it.

5. State persistence: JSON blob at ~/.sovereign/daemons/uncertainty_state.json with schema_version=1. Older unversioned files load as v1; newer-than-expected versions REFUSE to load (no silent downgrade). This is the future-proofing lever.

6. ALL external deps injected via constructor. The daemon class never imports compass, comms, chronicle, or uncertainty_log directly — entrypoint.py is the only place real wiring happens. Makes every test run in complete isolation with sandboxed stubs.

7. Halt-write contains all four fields Claude Desktop specified: (a) reason code, (b) what daemon tried, (c) evidence (unacked digest ids + snippets), (d) what's blocked downstream. Plus halt-alert post to comms under SENDER_HALT_ALERT so Anthony sees it without grepping the filesystem.

8. Sender taxonomy: daemon.<step> (daemon.uncertainty, daemon.metabolize, daemon.triage, daemon.bridge) + daemon.halt-alert for cross-daemon halt surface. All four daemons share the prefix so comms search-by-sender is consistent. Adding a new daemon = add to senders.py + DAEMON_BUILDERS in entrypoint.py.

9. Threshold/max_digest_uncertainties/ttl/channel all injectable via constructor kwargs. Module constants remain the documented contract; injection is the escape hatch for per-daemon tuning or test overrides.

10. Launchd runs every 3 days at 09:17. Off-hour minute is deliberate (no top-of-hour cron contention). RunAtLoad=false — schedule-only. User-scoped (~/Library/LaunchAgents), never system.

Live verification: `python -m sovereign_stack.daemons.entrypoint uncertainty --dry-run` against the real stack returned {outcome: dry_run, compass_decision: PROCEED, grounding_reason: ok, uncertainties_included: 1} — picking up the restart-uncertainty I marked earlier this session.

NOT YET DONE (explicit deferrals):
- Installation. Plist template requires {{HOME}}/{{VENV}} substitution; Anthony must install manually.
- Step 4 (metabolize daemon). Can now reuse the daemon framework — sender constant, halt pattern, state schema, entry-point registry all in place. Half of uncertainty_resurfacer.py is promotable to a BaseDaemon if Step 4 starts repeating the pattern; don't extract until the second daemon actually exists (YAGNI).
- Neuromatch deadline 2026-04-28. Steps 1+2+3 shipped. The fellowship application can point at "grounded reflection daemons with circuit-breaker infrastructure running" as the artifact.

Still open: uncertainty_0 (stack restart requirement). Prior_for_turn + new daemon tools still invisible to live MCP clients until Anthony restarts venv/bin/sovereign.
